thread:
alex: T-minus 45m to the EU change window — quick sweep. Who's on smoke and who's owning rollback/unpin? @maria @liz @shawn

maria: I can run the smoke suite for EU (embed + chat flows). Will kick off now and post results. link to runbook: https://go/release-smoke-eu

shawn: Pin request: locking service -> v3.2 (candidate rc3). No DB migrations in this drop. Rollback thresholds proposed: error_rate > 3% (5m rolling) OR p95 latency > 800ms for 5m. If hit, immediate unpin + revert traffic. @liz own rollback?

liz: I will own rollback/unpin. Ops-oncall as primary pager. I'll watch traces and make call. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary kickoff: eu-cluster-1 -> v3.2 (canary 5%)
```
deploy-bot: canary_id=canary-1716504321
status=STARTED
created_by=alex
variants=[v3.2]
canary_target=5%
```

ops-oncall: oncall is @sam for the window. Sam is aware and watching SLOs. I'll post dash links in a sec.

alex: one more housekeeping: release notes published https://docs.internal/releases/3.2 and the changelog includes perf fixes. Please do not push hotfixes to this branch during the window.

maria: starting smoke script: `/scripts/smoke_eu.sh --subset embed,chat --run-id=eu-1716504321`

maria: smoke results: embed sanity ✅, chat end-to-end ✅, quick load test at target qps shows p95 +50ms vs baseline. No functional regressions. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary metrics snapshot:
```
canary_id=canary-1716504321
metrics={ error_rate: 0.2%, p95_latency_ms: 210, qps: 48 }

```

shawn: rolling to 30% now. Pin written to rollout config: `rollout.v1.target=30%`, pinned_version=v3.2. Docs/infra updated.

liz: holding at 30% for 10m, will approve open to 100% if stable. Rolling rollback trigger: if error_rate > 3% OR p95 > 800ms for 5m. I'll call it and execute unpin.

alex: thanks — if anything weird, call it immediately. After we hit 100% please drop quick notes in #release-notes and mute non-critical alerts. I'll monitor for next 20m.

maria: copying smoke logs to the release thread and tagging owners. All green so far.

shawn: will follow up with a short post-deploy checklist: metrics, tracing sample, canary logs; planning a 1h retro if any anomalies.

liz: acknowledged. starting 10m timer. :stopwatch:

ops-oncall: dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/rollouts/eu-1716504321 ; alerts configured for the thresholds above.

alex: closing the loop — tactical silence in effect for the next 40m, no merges to release branch. Good job team. :rocket:
